info.title: WorkoutX API
info.description:
## The most comprehensive exercise API

**WorkoutX API** gives you instant access to **1,321 exercises** with high-quality GIF animations,
detailed instructions, muscle targeting data, effort levels, mechanics, force type, calorie estimates, and more.

### Authentication

Pass your API key via header (recommended):
```
X-WorkoutX-Key: wx_your_api_key
```
Or as a query parameter:
```
?api-key=wx_your_api_key
```

### Response Headers

Every authenticated response includes quota and rate limit headers:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-WorkoutX-Plan` | Your current plan ID |
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Max requests per rate limit window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining this window |
| `X-Quota-Limit` | Monthly quota |
| `X-Quota-Remaining` | Monthly requests remaining |
| `X-Quota-Reset` | Date quota resets |

### Plans

| Plan | Price | Monthly Requests | Rate Limit | GIF Access |
|------|-------|-----------------|------------|------------|
| Free | $0/mo | 500 | 30/min | Full library |
| Basic | $9.99/mo | 3,000 | 150/min | 500 unique GIFs |
| Pro | $15.99/mo | 10,000 | 300/min | Full library |
| Ultra | $24.99/mo | 35,000 | 600/min | Full library |

Get your API key at [workoutx.io](https://workoutxapp.com)

ApiKeyQuery.name: api-key
ApiKeyQuery.description: Your WorkoutX API key as a query parameter

gifUrl.description: Pass your API key to retrieve the GIF. Free plan returns watermarked version.

description.example: Barbell Bench Press is a intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the Pectorals in the Chest region.

popularityRank.description: Derived 1–5 "common use" score (mechanic + equipment ubiquity + difficulty). Not engagement data.

isUnilateral.description: True for single-sided / alternating movement variations.

recommendedSets.description: Default set range for the movement type.

recommendedReps.description: Default rep range for the movement type.

joint_focus.description: Ultra: primary joint the target muscle acts through (anatomical, not clinical).

intensity_level.description: Ultra: exertion band derived from met.

patch.summary: Update the plan for an API key

get.description:
Returns the full exercise list. Optional filters can be combined and are
case-insensitive (`chest`, `Chest`, `CHEST` all match).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results (0 = all, plan limits apply)

get.description: Filter by multiple criteria simultaneously. Requires Basic plan or higher.

parameters.name: jointFocus
parameters.description: Ultra plan — Joint & Rehab Metadata. Filter by the primary joint the movement's target muscle acts through (a derived, anatomical field — not a clinical or rehab recommendation). Useful for joint-based shortlists in physical therapy / mobility / senior-fitness apps.

parameters.name: intensityLevel
parameters.description: Ultra plan — Joint & Rehab Metadata. Derived overall-exertion band computed from the exercise's MET value.

parameters.name: movementTag
parameters.description: Ultra plan — Joint & Rehab Metadata. Filter by a derived descriptive movement tag (e.g. "joint-friendly" surfaces beginner-level, single-joint, gentle-pace movements tied to a specific joint).

get.summary: Dataset-sync changelog — exercises added/updated since a date (Ultra only)
get.description:
Returns exercises added or updated on or after the `since` date, newest
first, each annotated with `addedAt`, `updatedAt`, and `changeType`
(added | updated). Keep a local mirror of the dataset in sync and pick up
new exercises and GIFs added during your subscription without re-pulling
everything. Ultra plan only.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO date/datetime. Returns items changed on or after this.

200.description: Changed exercises since the given date

get.summary: Get a single exercise by ID

get.description:
Returns exercises that closely match the given one based on target muscle,
body part, mechanics, force type, secondary muscles, and effort level.
Each result includes a `similarityScore` (higher = more similar).

get.summary: Get alternative exercises (same target, different equipment)
get.description:
Finds exercises that hit the same target muscle but use different
equipment — perfect for "I don't have a barbell" scenarios.
Optionally prefer a specific equipment via `?equipment=dumbbell`
or exclude one via `?excludeEquipment=machine`.

parameters.name: excludeEquipment
parameters.description: Exclude alternatives using this equipment (defaults to source exercise's equipment)

get.summary: Estimate calorie burn for an exercise
get.description:
Returns estimated calories burned based on the exercise's per-minute
calorie value (70kg baseline), scaled to the user's weight.
Formula: `kcal = baseKcalPerMin × (weightKg / 70) × minutes`

Returns the exercise GIF for the given ID.
- **Free plan**: watermarked GIF
- **Basic plan**: up to 500 unique exercise GIFs per account
- **Paid plans**: original high-quality GIF

Subject to the plan's rate limit and monthly request quota
(both enforced by the auth middleware).

When Supabase is configured, streams from CDN.
Otherwise serves directly from the server filesystem.

403.description: Basic plan unique GIF limit reached

200.description: API is reachable (see `dependencies` for DB/Redis health)

get.description:
Curated supplement database with goals, timing, typical dosages, and
evidence levels. Informational content only — not medical advice.

parameters.name: timing
parameters.description: Filter by intake timing (pre_workout, post_workout, intra_workout, morning, evening, with_meals, any_time)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, summary, or category

200.description: List of supplements (sorted by evidence level)

403.description: Plan upgrade required (Pro or Ultra plan needed)

get.summary: Available supplement filter values (Pro & Ultra only)
get.description: Lists all categories, goals, timings, and evidence levels with counts.

Returns an ordered supplement stack for a training goal, sized by level,
with a timing guide grouping each item by when it's typically taken.
Informational content only — not medical advice.

200.description: Ordered supplement stack with timing guide

get.summary: Supplements relevant to an exercise (Pro & Ultra only)
get.description:
Maps the exercise's training context (resistance vs cardio) to goals and
returns the most relevant supplements, strongest evidence first.

get.summary: Get a single supplement by ID (Pro & Ultra only)
Generate a structured workout plan (Pro & Ultra only)
get.description:
Returns a fully structured workout plan based on your preferences.
Each call generates a fresh plan — ideal for "today's workout" features.
Counts as 1 API call against your quota.

parameters.name: equipment
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of available equipment. Omit for any equipment.

parameters.name: split
parameters.description:
Which body parts to train in this session.
- full_body: chest, back, shoulders, legs, arms
- upper: chest, back, shoulders, arms
- lower: quads, hamstrings, glutes, lower back
- push: chest, shoulders, triceps
- pull: back, biceps
- legs: quads, hamstrings, calves
- core: abs, lower back
Ignored if bodyFocus is provided.

parameters.name: bodyFocus
parameters.description: Comma-separated body parts for full custom selection. Overrides split.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated exercise IDs to exclude (e.g. user dislikes or already did today)

parameters.name: seed

403.description: Plan upgrade required (Pro or Ultra plan needed)

get.summary: Generate a multi-week training program with progressive overload (Ultra only)
get.description:
Returns a periodised, multi-week program. Exercises are fixed per training
day so progress can be tracked week to week, while sets and intensity
follow a 4-week undulating block (3 build weeks + a deload) that repeats.
Counts as 1 API call. Ultra plan only.

parameters.name: daysPerWeek
parameters.description: Training days per week (sets the weekly split)

parameters.name: equipment
parameters.description: Comma-separated available equipment. Omit for any.
